overview.summary: 0.24 bundles two delegation-path defect fixes (guard-layer tool-policy enforcement; persona/model application with reachable pool routing and channel-neutral onboarding) and two scheduling operability features (built-in memory.journal job; run scheduled jobs on demand via CLI/API/Web UI). All four FISes were preflight-reconciled on 2026-08-06. Execution runs in dartclaw-public on the 0.24 milestone branch after 0.23 ships, with the bundle copied to dev/bundle/docs/specs/0.24/ per SPEC-LIFECYCLE.md.

sharedDecisions.title: AgentHarness.turn is the shared contract surface
sharedDecisions.description: S01 adds the agentId identity parameter and owns the ~23-file implementer/fake sweep; S02 builds on that landed signature and adds the non-empty-systemPrompt persona contract. S02 must re-resolve all code anchors after S01 lands (S01 produces, S02 consumes).

sharedDecisions.title: Delegated turns execute on task-pool workers, never the caller's harness
sharedDecisions.description: S01 closes on harness-boundary identity and guard evidence. S02 owns the routing change (session provider + spawn-on-demand) and the sole production sessions_send reachability smoke after S01 lands; S01 has no completion dependency on S02.

sharedDecisions.title: Shared user-guide files edited across dependent waves
sharedDecisions.description: S01 and S04 land first. S02 and S03 then run in parallel and edit shared user-guide files in different sections; merge documentation changes semantically.

sharedDecisions.title: Prompt-type jobs are runnable on demand regardless of origin
sharedDecisions.description: Owner decision 2026-08-05 (cross-cutting review F-1): S04 lands the generic on-demand seam and UI predicate first; S03 then opts the memory-journal – the first prompt-type built-in job – into that seam and its Web UI Run button. onExecute callback jobs stay excluded.

sharedDecisions.title: Exported FIS provenance is rewritten before public execution
sharedDecisions.description: The one-way exporter preserves content, so the exported copies' Plan headers must be rewritten from the private repo path to dev/bundle/docs/specs/0.24/plan.json and validated before exec-plan or exec-spec. Canonical private headers never change.

bindingConstraints.verbatim: Execute on the 0.24 milestone branch, after 0.23 ships – `feat/0.23` is scope-frozen (recorded in F3/F4 FISes and the F1/F2 target notes).

F2 executes only after F1 lands; F2's executor must re-resolve all code anchors against the then-current tree (F2 FIS Execution Contract).

F3 executes only after F1 and F4 land because it consumes F1's exact own-MCP `memory_save` semantic mapping and live guard seam, then opts the journal into F4's generic on-demand seam and UI predicate.

Milestone preflight completed 2026-08-06: delegated lifecycle, provider defaults, Codex and ACP persona transport, pool provisioning, cross-channel onboarding, journal tool boundary, reserved-ID collision, and live-proof requirements are settled in the FIS decision notes.
Per-milestone transient copy: on execution, specs copy to `dartclaw-public/dev/bundle/docs/specs/0.24/` per `SPEC-LIFECYCLE.md`; this private directory stays canonical.

stories.name: Agent tool policy enforcement on the live tool-call path
stories.scope: Per-agent tool whitelist enforced on every active host guard path via agent-identity threading (unconditional on Claude; approval-routed on Codex/ACP as documented in the FIS); per-agent network domain grants honored by NetworkGuard; unenforced spawn-config fields retired with loud warnings; user and architecture docs made honest. Excludes a second TaskToolFilterGuard enforcement layer, per-agent max_concurrent enforcement, agent renaming, and dispatch-flow changes.
stories.notes: FIS preflight-reconciled 2026-08-06; all decision notes are settled.

stories.name: Agent persona and model application on the delegation dispatch path
stories.scope: Delegated sessions_send turns run under the AgentDefinition persona prompt and configured model/effort (Claude/Codex; ACP persona-only with documented weaker authority), and delegation becomes reachable while the caller's turn is active via task-pool routing with awaitable spawn-on-demand and a clear inline error on exhaustion. Provider defaults resolve to Claude sonnet and Codex gpt-5.6-luna. ONBOARDING.md applies to every human-facing conversational channel while automated and delegated turns remain excluded. Ordinary turns have no delegated persona/model residue. Excludes tool enforcement (S01), per-agent provider, one-shot CLI delegation, and ACP model/effort wiring.
stories.notes: Preflight completed 2026-08-06; all recorded decisions are resolved and reconciled. Execute after S01 and re-resolve code anchors against the landed tree.

stories.name: Built-in memory journal job (memory.journal)
stories.scope: memory.journal.{enabled, schedule} config (default off) registers a built-in prompt-type cron job that distills the day's turn log into MEMORY.md through a closed file_read + memory_save tool boundary. Reserved-ID collisions fail startup. Journal/consolidation/pruning stay distinctly named and non-interfering; docs and the personal-assistant example adopt the toggle. A production-path live smoke proves memory_save persistence. Excludes delivery/model/prompt knobs, deterministic empty-day pre-checks, and any consolidation/pruning changes.
stories.notes: FIS preflight-reconciled 2026-08-06. Execute after S01 and S04 because this story consumes S01's own-MCP tool mapping and guard seam and opts the journal into S04's generic on-demand seam and UI predicate; it may run in parallel with S02.

stories.name: Run scheduled jobs on demand (CLI + API + Web UI)
stories.scope: A ScheduleService on-demand run seam with scheduled-fire parity (delivery, retries, pause-state and timer neutrality), fronted by POST /api/scheduling/jobs/<name>/run (202/404/409), a `dartclaw jobs run` CLI command, and a Web UI Run action with toast feedback. Excludes synchronous waits, restart-pending jobs, per-run overrides, scheduled-task (type: task) triggers, and run history.
stories.notes: FIS preflight-reconciled 2026-08-06. Touches templates/controllers – embedded-assets regeneration and icon strict-sync remain in-FIS gates.

riskSummary.mitigation: Doc-reviewed FIS with pinned implementer-sweep inventory (~23 files) and per-harness scenario tests; workspace-wide analyze/test gate catches cross-package interface breaks.
Preflight decisions are settled; executes only after S01 with anchors re-resolved; live sessions_send smoke proves delegated reachability and provider-specific persona/model application.
Executes after S01 and S04 with an exact file_read + memory_save tool policy, generic on-demand-seam integration, reserved-ID collision tests, wiring tests, and a required production-path live smoke.
Breadth (service + API + CLI + UI) contained by per-surface Verify lines, embedded-assets regen gate, and the icons strict-sync fitness check.

executionNotes: All four FISes were preflight-reconciled 2026-08-06 and remain authoritative – do not regenerate them. Execute in dartclaw-public on the 0.24 milestone branch after 0.23 ships. Export plan + FISes to dev/bundle/docs/specs/0.24/, then rewrite only the four exported FIS Plan headers to dev/bundle/docs/specs/0.24/plan.json and gate on the exported plan existing, exactly four canonical FISes carrying that public path, and none retaining docs/specs/0.24/plan.json; never rewrite the private sources. Wave 1 contains S01 and S04. Wave 2 contains S02 and S03 after both wave-1 dependencies land; S02 and S03 may run in parallel. Re-resolve code anchors against the landed tree and merge overlapping user-guide edits semantically.
